title: FGC 603: Log Lighters
officialText:
603.1 General.

Log lighters shall installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions.

603.2 Automatic Valves.

Automatic valves or semi-automatic valves shall be provided and shall comply with the applicable provisions of ANSI Z21.21/CSA 6.5.
